the combination of 5-FU with radiation therapy is effective and well tolerated for the palliative treatment of patients with unresectable bone sarcomas, that this combination is also effective in the treatment of patients with bone sarcoma who have had a previous surgical procedure, and that this combination is effective for the treatment of patients who have had previous radiation therapy to a bone sarcoma site.
the combination of radiation therapy with chemotherapy is more effective than chemotherapy alone for patients with osteosarcoma.

The main takeaway from our work is that

there is no single best approach to radiation therapy for patients with bone sarcomas, but that each patient should be treated on an individual basis, with the best treatment approach selected based on the patient’s age, location of the sarcoma, size of the sarcoma and the patient’s general health status.
